## Overview

Jay Esmalla builds practical mobile and web applications with clear interfaces and reliable backend architectures:
- **Mobile Development:** Flutter, Dart, React Native, Expo
- **Frontend Engineering:** React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Next.js, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS
- **Backend & Data:** Node.js, Python, PHP, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Firebase, Supabase, Drizzle ORM
- **Tools & Infrastructure:** Git, GitHub, Figma, Docker

## Software Projects (7)

1. **1561 VULSHOP** (Web — TanStack Start, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Drizzle ORM, MySQL 8, Better Auth, Docker)
   - Full-stack workshop operations, inventory, and payroll system for 1561 Tire & Vulcanizing Services. Features a 4-stage job queue, split cash/GCash payments, transactional stock deductions, and automated daily 60/40 commission payroll.
2. **Aralytics** (Web — React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS)
   - Study workspace that organizes notes, flashcards, and practice sessions into a clean review flow.
3. **LakBai** (Mobile — React Native, Expo, TypeScript)
   - Offline-first mobile travel companion for exploring destinations and local spots across Davao del Norte.
4. **PRISM** (Web — PHP, MySQL, JavaScript)
   - Hospital payroll and staff management system developed for Tagum Doctors Hospital, automating shift attendance, overtime, statutory deductions, and payslip generation.
5. **Thryfto** (Mobile — Flutter, Dart, Firebase, Python)
   - Peer-to-peer mobile thrift marketplace with real-time listings, seller profiles, and Firebase backend services.
   - Source: https://github.com/JayEsmalla/thryfto-app
6. **LolasKusina** (Web — React, Node.js, MySQL)
   - Catering and food-tray ordering web application for browsing menus, scheduling deliveries, and managing kitchen orders.
7. **ComLab V3 Egress Simulation** (Web — JavaScript, HTML5 Canvas, CSS)
   - Agent-based emergency egress simulation modeling crowd bottlenecks and exit paths in a university computer laboratory.
   - Live: https://simulation-comlab-v3.vercel.app/
   - Source: https://github.com/JayEsmalla/simulation_comlabV3
